links.outcome: Leakage-free patient-wise split and external validation of performance
links.effect: Strict patient-wise splits with zero overlap and test set unused for tuning; external data from a different scanner showed lower zero-shot accuracy (66.1% vs 70.3%).
links.quote: All hyperparameter decisions (architecture choice, loss weights, augmentation settings, early stopping/model selection, and TTA) were made using training/validation only; the held‐out test sets were not used for any tuning or selection decisions.

links.effect: Selective fine-tuning raised external held-out accuracy from 66.1% to 80.0%, QWK to 0.950, and KL≥2 AUC to 0.984.
